classes.B: must be REJECTED at compile time, at marked lines
classes.C: compiles, runs, reports PASSED or NOT-APPLICABLE
classes.D: exact arithmetic on large literals; a capacity error also passes
classes.E: runs and reports TENTATIVELY PASSED; graded by inspection
classes.L: must fail to BIND; must not begin execution

extensions..AM: Ada source carrying the main subprogram of a multi-file test
extensions..AU: Ada source with characters outside 7-bit ASCII (UTF-8 with BOM)
extensions..C: C source, for a foreign-language-interface test
extensions..CBL: Cobol source, for a foreign-language-interface test
extensions..FTN: Fortran source, for a foreign-language-interface test
extensions..TST: legacy test carrying macro symbols; must be expanded first

frontend: none — lexical scanner in this file; no Ada parser
